text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон wins the Champions Cup.
The fans
cheer loudly as she goes all out
at the winning
concert.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Looking out at each of her fans as they
gaze back
in adoration, Смарт Фалкон
sees her own radiance
once again. Her
spirits have made a full recovery.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
To give Смарт Фалкон a little extra push
as she's
getting back in stride, I make a
small suggestion
after the winning
concert...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We decide to throw a holiday meet and
greet for
her fans before the Tokyo
Daishoten, her final
challenge.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
